data: A MEASUREMENT DOCUMENT, not a registrable form (the founder's question 15 October 2026 08:3x UK: a whole new programme every hash on a card; the project's order): fp_mode 9 SELECT-ALL. The step's operation is drawn PER HASH PER STEP: for step t three words from the hash's seed chain (z[(3t+j) mod 8] = fchain(z, 8192 + 3t + j)), slot k's drawn operation fchain(w0, k) mod 8, its immediate fchain(w1, k), its variant fchain(w2, k); the operands and the destination version 20's static wiring (d = k, a = 7k + 1, b = 11k + 5 mod 32). Every lane computes ALL EIGHT candidates on its operands every slot (add a+b+imm, sub a-b-imm, xor a^b^imm, and/or (the variant's bit) ^imm, rotate left by (imm^b) mod 32, mul a*b+imm, mulhi ^imm, cross-lane R[lane+1+(q mod 15)][a]+imm) and selects the drawn one by a mask with no branch (d = OR over c of (-(c == sel)) & cand[c]). No period programme (program_ops 1, sequence 1: the shapes unused, the period seed still digested), no scratchpad and no window (the state 32 registers a lane, 2 KiB an attempt), no pair sequence (the programme is the hash's own), the keyed read every second step with the index drawn 16 steps ahead (fold_every 2, prefetch 16: 64 items and 16 KiB a hash, as the k2-lean form of record), the lean fixed cost (the mix over the 16 lanes' 16-byte accumulators). Everything but the programme discipline as DOC-v21-forge2-anvilr-pair-k2-lean-p64-m16-l8-s128, so the GPU team's rows on both cards and the security review's price read the discipline alone.
counters: USEFUL OPERATIONS A HASH: 128 steps x 32 slots x 16 lanes = 65,536 selected operations (the trace counts them by class: IALU for the four integer candidates, ROT, MUL, MULHI, XLANE). COMPUTED OPERATIONS A HASH: 8 x 65,536 = 524,288 candidates plus 65,536 eight-way masked selects (each select 8 compares, 8 ands and 7 ors on a scalar card; one select instruction a candidate where the card has it), so the card issues at least 8x the useful work and the useful share of the issued operations is at most 1 in 8 before the selects; the keyed reads 64 items (16 KiB) a hash and the lean mix unchanged. The reference's IGNPOW_TRACE line 'forge2 select-all' prints the useful operations, the computed candidates and the selects a hash.
fits_die_sram_7nm: no (the gigabyte 8.6 Gbit); a chip's SRAM an attempt 2 KiB
red_team_chip_row: pending: the security review prices it (the project's order 08:3x UK); the fabric has no fixed programme to wire, since every hash's every step draws its own operation, so the adversary's chip is a DECODER: eight functional units a lane behind a mask, or one unit a lane chosen by the draw, with the draw's fold chain (3 words a step, 32 fchain draws a step) on the chip beside it; the card's cost is the 8x computed work, the chip's is the decoder's area
floating: integer-only: no FP32 class among the eight candidates, no exponent mask anywhere in the attempt; the floating counters read 0 on every set
fixed_cost: bytes hashed a hash as the k2-lean form's (the work seed 72, the programme seed 72, the period seed 80 once a batch, the init 72, the lean mix 32 + 32 + 1 + 256 = 321, the final digest 64: about 680) and the step chain 384 fchain draws a hash for the words plus 128 x 32 x 3 = 12,288 fchain draws for the per-slot class, immediate and variant (the draw cost the card pays per hash, the chip's decoder pays per slot)
measurement: the GPU team measures it as mined on both cards today (the 4090 and the 5090) against the k2-lean form of record's rows; the figure of record is the card's uJ a hash and its ratio to the k2-lean row; the verifier figure on the build box's core is stated below as cut, the minimum node's row decides
